label: cdf-source_record
sql: SELECT _change_type,count(*),min(_commit_version),max(_commit_version),sha2(concat_ws('',sort_array(collect_list(sha2(concat(CASE WHEN source_feed IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_feed AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_feed AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_epoch IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_epoch AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_epoch AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN delivery_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(delivery_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(delivery_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN record_kind IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(record_kind AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(record_kind AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_cursor_json IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_cursor_json AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_cursor_json AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN payload_json IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(payload_json AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(payload_json AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN payload_digest IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(payload_digest AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(payload_digest AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN schema_revision IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(schema_revision AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(schema_revision AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN received_at IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(received_at AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(received_at AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN apply_batch_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(apply_batch_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(apply_batch_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END),256)))),256) FROM table_changes('client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.mixed_source_record_r332',5,5) GROUP BY _change_type ORDER BY _change_type
